title: Add work samples section to portfolio
description:
Create a new Work Samples/Projects section to showcase notable work and projects.

Requirements:
- Create new component /components/WorkSamples.tsx (client component with animations)
- Create data file /data/workSamples.ts with TypeScript interface
- Design should match existing sections (similar to Experience timeline)
- Each sample should include: title, description, technologies used, optional link, optional image/screenshot
- Integrate into /app/page.tsx between Experience and Footer
- Ensure mobile responsive and dark mode compatible
close_reason:
Work Samples section successfully implemented and integrated.

Created Files:
✅ /data/workSamples.ts - TypeScript interface and sample data
   - WorkSample interface with fields: id, title, description, technologies, link, image, category
   - 4 sample projects including S3 platform, BDR platform, Home Energy Reports, and portfolio website
   
✅ /components/WorkSamples.tsx - Client component with animations
   - Framer Motion scroll animations
   - Grid layout (2 columns on desktop, 1 on mobile)
   - Category badges with icons
   - Optional external links and images support
   - Technology tags with gradient styling
   - Dark mode compatible
   - Matches existing design system (purple-to-pink gradient accent)

✅ /app/page.tsx - Integration
   - Added WorkSamples component between Experience and Footer sections
   - Maintains proper page flow and visual hierarchy

Build Verification:
✅ Next.js build completed successfully (1.2s compile time)
✅ Work Samples section included in /out/index.html (79KB)
✅ TypeScript compilation passed with no errors
✅ All animations and styling consistent with existing sections

Design Features:
- Responsive grid layout (1 col mobile, 2 col desktop)
- Hover effects and shadow transitions
- Category badges (Professional Work, Personal Project, Open Source)
- Optional external link icons
- Technology tag pills with gradients
- Alternating background colors (gray-50/gray-900) for visual separation from Experience section
- Purple-to-pink gradient accent (vs blue-to-purple in Experience) for visual distinction

The section is production-ready and can be customized by editing /data/workSamples.ts to add more projects, links, or images.

title: Analyze Duke Football Invitational project and add to work samples
description:
Analyze the Duke Football Invitational project and add it to the work samples section.

Resources:
- Website: https://will.moore.fyi/duke-football-invitational/weekly-reports/index.html
- GitHub: https://github.com/willmoorefyi/duke-football-invitiational-summary-generator

Tasks:
1. Fetch and analyze the live website to understand what it does
2. Fetch and analyze the GitHub repository (README, code structure, tech stack)
3. Write a concise summary of the project (what it does, why it was built)
4. Identify key technologies used
5. Add entry to /data/workSamples.ts with:
   - Title
   - Description (2-3 sentences)
   - Technologies array
   - Category (e.g., 'Web App', 'Data Visualization', etc.)
   - Links to both website and GitHub repo
   - Optional: Screenshot if appropriate
